claim_text: Winter storm bundles distinct mechanisms; v0.1 governs the snow (+ glaze weight) gravity-load pathway only.
permitted_inference: Govern snow (+glaze) gravity load as the v0.1 primary pathway; other winter mechanisms are separate.
prohibited_inference: Default any winter mechanism to this pathway.

claim_text: 1 mm of snow water equivalent is 1 kg/m2, i.e. 9.80665 Pa of ground load.
permitted_inference: Convert SWE to areal load without a density assumption.
prohibited_inference: Converting snow depth without measured density.
reasoning: Water-equivalent depth fixes mass per area by definition.

claim_text: Glaze weight on a flat surface is approximately pi x rho_i x equivalent radial ice thickness x g.
permitted_inference: Add glaze weight on flat surfaces as pi x 0.9 x radial thickness of water.
prohibited_inference: Treating the identity as exact when wind-driven accretion contributes.
reasoning: With no wind the Simple model gives Req = P/(pi rho_i); flat accumulation equals P; with wind the identity overstates.
update_trigger: A flat-surface glaze measurement product from the hazard grid.

claim_text: Array snow load follows ASCE 7-22 pf = 0.7 Ce Ct pg with slope reduction lost when the leading edge is buried.
parameter_or_rule: load_bridge: pf = 0.7 Ce Ct pg; Ce 0.9, Ct 1.2 defaults; Cs default 1.0
permitted_inference: Bridge ground load to array load for the module axis; no slope credit by default.
prohibited_inference: Applying a slippery-surface Cs credit without verified clearance/stow.
reasoning: ASCE 7-22 Eq 7.3-1 via secondary sources; practitioner calc shows Ce/Ct choices and Cs loss at low clearance.
update_trigger: ASCE 7-22 Ch.7 text or the ASCE 2025 ground-mount book.

claim_text: In ASCE 7-22 the mapped ground snow load is a strength-level value (load factor 1.0).
parameter_or_rule: axis semantics: r = 1 at the ASCE 7-22 strength-level design load
permitted_inference: Define the structure axis against the strength-level pg.
prohibited_inference: A return period for a site from r.
reasoning: ASCE 7-22 ground snow loads are strength-level with load factor 1.0.

claim_text: Seven full-scale ground-mount racks failed at 0.97-3.28 times their design pressure (median 1.88, log-sd 0.47).
parameter_or_rule: structure capacity ratios {3.28,1.35,0.97,2.17,2.91,1.21,2.54}; lognormal median 1.88, beta 0.47
permitted_inference: Anchor the support-structure capacity spread and median relative to manufacturer design.
prohibited_inference: Treating n=7 Japanese fixed-tilt racks as a calibrated population fragility.
reasoning: Full-scale tests measured collapse load / design load directly.
update_trigger: More full-scale tests or US forensic data.

claim_text: The test design load maps onto the ASCE 7-22 axis with an unresolved factor between about 0.56 and 1.0.
permitted_inference: Carry three unweighted resistance scenarios for the Japanese-to-ASCE design-load mapping.
prohibited_inference: Presenting scenarios as percentiles or a calibrated distribution.
reasoning: Test design pressure maps to ASCE 7-22 r via 1/1.8 (old 50-yr nominal), 0.7 (ASD) or 1.0; mapping unverified.
update_trigger: A US full-scale test against ASCE 7-22 design loads.

claim_text: Japanese reported snow events damaged about 37%, about 80%, and 100% of the affected arrays.
permitted_inference: Set partial (~37%) and extensive (~80% to total) collapse states.
reasoning: Regulator cases report per-event damaged share once snow exceeded design.
update_trigger: A larger case set with load data.

claim_text: Rack collapse is brittle: global collapse follows first member buckling closely.
permitted_inference: Keep extensive collapse close to collapse onset (brittle buckling).
reasoning: Post buckling was followed immediately by global collapse; cold-formed members have little reserve.
update_trigger: Tests reporting the load gap between first buckling and full collapse.

claim_text: Modern large-format tracker modules fail at about 1.8-2.8 kPa uniform downforce.
parameter_or_rule: module direct capacity scenario medians 1.8 / 2.3 / 2.8 kPa before knock-down; beta 0.25 (T4)
permitted_inference: Place module breakage on absolute array load.
reasoning: Lab test-to-failure populations and MSS failures bound modern module capacity.

claim_text: Snow concentrates at the module lower edge, below the uniform-test capacity.
permitted_inference: Reduce module capacity for lower-edge snow concentration.
reasoning: Lower-edge loading is measured as concentrated but no factor is published.
update_trigger: IEC 62938 load table or AIST eave-load values.

claim_text: Modules on collapsed racking are mostly lost; modules can also fail without racking damage.
permitted_inference: Make modules on collapsed rows mostly nonsalvageable, once.
reasoning: Collapsed racks dropped or broke modules; module-only state exists separately.

claim_text: Tracker snow capacity is a project choice (5 psf standard, up to 60 psf).
permitted_inference: Require a declared design basis; screening assumes site code.
prohibited_inference: Assuming a tracker meets site code without stating it.
reasoning: Trackers ship at 5 psf standard unless configured up.

claim_text: Snow stow and snow removal can reduce load but have no published efficacy.
permitted_inference: Capture stow and snow removal; no numeric credit.
prohibited_inference: Crediting stow or removal without efficacy evidence.
reasoning: Unknown mitigation receives no credit (pressure-test checklist).

parameter_or_rule: capacity spread includes design deficiency (beta 0.47; lower scenario)
permitted_inference: Represent under-design through the measured spread and the lower scenario, not a separate multiplier.
prohibited_inference: A separate deficiency multiplier on top of the measured spread.
reasoning: Field collapses are dominated by under-design; the tested sample already includes weak racks.
update_trigger: Population data on as-built design compliance.

reasoning: All tested racks are fixed-tilt; tracker torque tubes, drives and stow differ.
